description:
[ Official English Translation ](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/145958)

The daughter of an American ambassador is kidnapped. Government officials in Faldum think that an infamous terror group is responsible for the kidnapping but they can’t be sure. So, they call in a favor from the Golden Knight, aka Mel, one of Faldum’s original knights. A covert operation is set in motion with Mel at the head. Mel had saved King Isaac’s life back when he was the crowned prince and Isaac had never forgotten the Golden Knight who saved him. It turns out that the covert operation was nothing more than an excuse to get Mel back by the King’s side since he had never really gotten over his feelings for the Golden Knight. Will the knight return his feelings?
